changesSinceV3: Expanded the v3 activity/emote set with 20+ plushie and social actions.
Added shared room emote chains, including Start a Wave Emote with left-to-right sequencing.
Wave participants now raise both arms for 3 seconds and return to BC's BaseUpper arm pose.
Added Raise Both Arms with a 5-second temporary OverTheHead pose and reliable BaseUpper reset.
Added Measure Height with dynamic height-comparison chat text and sender-side local rendering.
Added nickname-aware dialogue so action text uses character nicknames/display names correctly.
Updated plushie action dialogue to include the selected plushie's name where appropriate.
Added expression reactions for supported activities.
Added activity/search improvements for the extra/social action menus.
Removed the automatic hourly room-mascot cycle; mascot changes are manual.
Updated room mascot behavior and compatibility handling.
Moved poke-style jealousy behavior into Jealous and added boop/bap handling to Protect.
Changed affection idle decay to -1 every 8 hours for plushies that are not currently being held.
Held plushies are excluded from idle affection decay.
Improved drag/move/resize persistence and plushie positioning behavior.
Improved gender-aware and possessive action text.
Improved synced/non-local emote and custom activity networking.
Improved custom activity packet normalization so plugin actions survive R132 activity packet differences.
Improved sender-side chat rendering and duplicate suppression for custom plugin actions.
Added arm-pose diagnostics and console helpers for testing/resetting temporary poses.
Added Rey plushie using assets/plushies/rey.png.
Added Rey's built-in lore.
Added Margot plushie using assets/plushies/margot.png.
Added a hidden-lore placeholder for Margot.
Preserved legacy Subbycat wire option 18 for backwards compatibility while adding Rey and Margot.
Expanded the public plushie count to 20.
Kept Opera/R132-compatible bootstrap and userscript loading behavior.

Fixed nickname/pronoun-aware custom activities disappearing from chat. All Subby's Plushies custom activities now use the same deterministic local chat-row renderer for both sender and receiving addon clients, with token-based duplicate suppression.

Fixed sender-side custom action text: outgoing plugin activities are now rendered synchronously from the exact normalized packet before ServerSend, and locally-created chat rows no longer carry sender/target routing metadata that could cause BC to suppress the actor's own row.

Reworked sender-side custom emote rendering to reuse the proven Measure Height path: BC finishes ServerSend first, then the generated action row is appended on the next event-loop tick using the simple ChatMessageAction row. Duplicate suppression now requires an actual matching DOM row, not merely a previously-seen token.

Added Ignore Pose-Changing Emotes. When enabled, Wave and Raise Both Arms keep their chat text but perform no pose changes on the local client. Also made arm animations kneeling-safe by changing only the upper-body pose family (BaseUpper/OverTheHead) instead of passing the full ActivePose array, so kneeling/sitting lower-body poses are preserved.

Fixed Pose Safety exposure and command registration. Ignore Pose-Changing Emotes is now the first dedicated Extension Settings section and has a guaranteed handheld Settings slot with a visible v3.1.14 status line. Both /plushieignoreposes and plushieignoreposes are accepted, /plushieversion was added, critical safety commands are preserved even after Git command data refresh, and enabling pose-ignore immediately cancels active Wave/Raise Both Arms poses.

Moved Backup / Restore out of the top-level Extensions navigation and into Progress as a third sub-tab beside Stats and Achievements. /plushiebackup now opens Progress → Backup, and legacy attempts to open the old backup tab are redirected there automatically.

Moved Battle History out of the top-level Extensions navigation and into Progress as its own sub-tab beside Stats, Achievements, and Backup. /plushiehistory now opens Progress → Battle History, and legacy requests to open the old History tab are redirected there automatically.

Cleaned up the handheld Settings layout: removed the Pose Safety/version status text and moved Back to plushies into a dedicated compact top-right Settings button so it no longer overlaps the feature controls.

Refined the handheld menu layout: Back to plushies now lives inside the actual top-right menu header, the Balance Minigame menu button was removed, plushie pages now show 14 entries instead of 12, and the Next/Previous Page button was moved down into the row previously occupied by Balance Minigame.

Reorganized the Extensions control center and plush selector: plushie pages now show 16 entries, Layout moved under Settings as a General/Layout sub-tab, and Plushies moved under Progress while Lore remains a top-level tab. Legacy commands and direct tab requests redirect to the new locations.

Reworked custom activity artwork into three shared assets. Hair actions use assets/plushies/hairaction.png, cheek/face actions use assets/plushies/faceaction.png, Point Dramatically uses assets/plushies/pointing.png, and every action outside those categories—including Hug Tightly—uses the default subbycat.png artwork. The resolver now covers both plushie activities and Extra Actions.

Updated repository documentation and command reference. README.md now documents the current v3.1.21 feature set, navigation, plushies, actions, action-image mapping, pose safety, data files, and complete command catalog. The in-addon Commands tab now includes the current navigation layout and documents /plushieversion in the authoritative command list. commands.json is synchronized with the executable commands.

changes: Started the v3 release line.
Expanded the activity/emote system with 20+ new actions and emotes.
Removed automatic hourly mascot cycling.
Added shared emote-chain support and expression reactions.
Added nickname-aware dialogue and improved plushie-name-aware action text.
Added extra/social activity improvements and search support.
Changed idle affection decay to -1 every 8 hours for unheld plushies.
Updated Protect/Jealous action keyword behavior.
Added temporary raised-arm pose handling and arm-pose diagnostics.
Made pending custom activities authoritative during outgoing R132 activity packets.
Improved Raise Arms, shared Wave, and Measure Height dispatch/network behavior.
Renamed the wave activity to Start a Wave Emote.
Changed arm action wording to Raise Both Arms.
Improved sender-side Measure Height rendering.
Added direct local chat rendering for outgoing custom actions.
Added duplicate suppression for matching server echoes.
Set Wave arm hold time to exactly 3 seconds.
Improved temporary arm-pose restoration logic.
Changed temporary arm reset behavior toward a consistent base posture.
Fixed the arm reset correctly by replacing OverTheHead with BaseUpper.
Kept BaseLower/lower-body pose independent from upper-body arm resetting.
Added SubbysPlushiesArmReset() diagnostic helper.
Added Rey plushie and built-in Rey lore.
Added Margot plushie with hidden lore.
Preserved legacy Subbycat wire option 18.
Expanded public plushie count to 20.
Fixed the stale internal bootstrap version so all v3.1.9 version constants match.
Fixed pronoun/nickname-aware custom emotes not appearing in chat.
All custom plugin activities now render for the sender through one common chat-row path.
Receiving addon clients render the same generated text directly instead of relying on R132's synthetic Beep action renderer.
Added per-action token deduplication so server echoes do not create duplicate chat rows.
Fixed the actor not seeing their own pronoun/nickname-aware custom action text.
Outgoing custom actions now render locally before ServerSend instead of waiting for a possible self echo.
Removed data-sender/data-target routing metadata from manually-created local action rows.
Receiving players continue to see the same generated text through the network packet.
Reused the working Measure Height sender-side chat rendering path for every custom activity.
Outgoing custom action rows are appended after ServerSend completes, on the next event-loop tick.
Restored the simple ChatMessage ChatMessageAction row class used by the working height-comparison fix.
Fixed token deduplication so a token only suppresses rendering when its chat row actually exists.
Added Ignore Pose-Changing Emotes setting in the handheld Settings page and Extension Settings.
Added /plushieignoreposes command.
When ignored, Wave and Raise Both Arms still show chat text but do not move characters locally.
Changed temporary arm animation to use only the upper-body pose family.
Wave and Raise Both Arms no longer submit the whole ActivePose array, preventing kneeling/sitting characters from being stood up.
Made Ignore Pose-Changing Emotes the first dedicated Extension Settings section.
Moved Ignore Pose Changes to a guaranteed visible handheld Settings slot.
Added visible Pose Safety/version status text to handheld Settings.
Made plushieignoreposes work with or without the leading slash.
Added /plushieversion for verifying the actually running build.
Protected critical pose-safety commands from Git commands.json refreshes.
Protected the pose-ignore default from older defaults.json files.
Enabling pose-ignore immediately cancels and resets active Wave/Raise Both Arms sessions.
Removed Backup from the top-level Extensions tabs.
Added Backup as a third Progress sub-tab beside Stats and Achievements.
Kept all existing Export Backup and Import Backup behavior unchanged.
Updated /plushiebackup to open Progress → Backup.
Added compatibility redirect for code that still tries to open the old backup tab.
Removed History from the top-level Extensions tabs.
Added Battle History as a Progress sub-tab.
Kept the existing last-20 battle history renderer and data unchanged.
Updated /plushiehistory to open Progress → Battle History.
Added compatibility redirect for code that still opens the old History tab.
Removed the Pose Safety/version status text from handheld Settings.
Moved Back to plushies into a dedicated top-right Settings button.
Removed the old centered Back to plushies button that overlapped the settings controls.
Moved Back to plushies from the Settings body into the actual top-right menu header.
Removed the Balance Minigame button from the handheld plushie menu.
Kept Balance on Head/minigame functionality available through its activity and /plushiebalance command.
Increased plushie list page size from 12 to 14 entries.
Moved Next/Previous Page to the old Balance Minigame row at the bottom of the plushie list.
Increased plushie selector page size from 14 to 16 entries.
Adjusted selector row spacing so eight rows fit cleanly per page.
Removed Layout from the top-level Extensions tabs.
Added General and Layout sub-tabs inside Settings.
Removed Plushies from the top-level Extensions tabs.
Added Plushies as a Progress sub-tab.
Kept Lore as a top-level tab.
Updated /plushielayout to open Settings → Layout.
Updated /plushieplushies and /plushieposes to open Progress → Plushies.
Legacy direct requests for layout/plushies redirect to their new locations.
Added shared hairaction.png artwork for Ruffle Hair, Brush Hair From Face, Tuck Hair Behind Ear, and Twirl Hair.
Added shared faceaction.png artwork for face/cheek actions such as Rub Against Face, cheek interactions, Nose Boop, Forehead Bump, and Squeeze Cheeks.
Added pointing.png artwork for Point Dramatically.
All remaining custom activities now use subbycat.png as their action artwork.
Hug Tightly no longer uses hugtightly.png; it now uses subbycat.png.
Expanded the action-image resolver to include Extra Actions as well as plushie actions.
If any of the three shared action images fail to load, the plugin falls back to subbycat.png.
Rewrote README.md to match the current v3 feature set and UI organization.
Added the complete current command reference to README.md.
Updated the in-addon Commands tab with the current Settings/Progress navigation layout.
Added /plushieversion to the authoritative built-in command documentation.
